entries.finding: hint 2 'so they do not build up in layers' and gabbro line 'so it has no layers' are unscoped absolutes
entries.reason: Igneous rocks can show layering (layered gabbro intrusions, stacked lava flows). The point the question needs is that they do not form by sediment settling.
entries.change: hint2: 'not from material settling layer upon layer'. Gabbro line: 'not built up from settled layers'.

entries.finding: check 11: 'surface' used in two senses, answer text vs surface irrigation in exam tip

entries.change: Principle: replaced 'In the syllabus this is the option that matches its definition' with a note that 'surface' here only means the water lands on top of the farmland, and is not the syllabus's surface irrigation (furrows or basins).
